LanguageData.SSC_Setting_EnableCorruptionDecay_Desc: When disabled, Corruption does not naturally decrease. Apparel floors and Sex Slave Chain caps still apply.
LanguageData.SSC_Setting_CorruptionDecayPerDay_Desc: Sets the base amount of Corruption lost per day before Sex need, recent Training score, opinion, Chain stage, body-part development, apparel, and health modifiers are applied. Default: 2%.
